slides.title: Now it's a stiff-leg deadlift.
slides.body: Legs straight, bar still on the floor. You skipped the first part of the lift.

slides.title: You yanked it off the floor.
slides.body: Every loaded bar has slack in it. Jerk it and your hips shoot up looking for the tension you skipped.

slides.title: Pull the slack out first.
slides.body: Arms long, lats on. Lift until the bar clicks against the plates. Only then does the rep start.

slides.title: Push the floor away.
slides.body: Think leg press, not pull. Hips and shoulders rise at the same speed until the bar passes your knees.

slides.title: Film one set from the side.
slides.body: If your hips move and the bar doesn't, take some weight off and own the start.
